sentences.text: Researchers examined how proteins BOC and CDON regulate cytonemes in cells that produce Sonic Hedgehog, noting that removing CDON in mouse spinal cord tissue reduced these structures and altered neuron development.
The authors suggest a model where proteins binding Sonic Hedgehog help move signals by encouraging the growth of long cytonemes, as removing BOC and CDON lowered Cdc42 activity at protrusion tips.
